summary.en: A list steps up one row per beat; the word in the lens changes tone and face, and the ground follows it, all on the beat.
summary.zh: 一列词每拍上移一行，取景框里的词换色调换字形，背景跟着变，全都踩在拍上。

fits: A run of five to ten names the film wants felt rather than read: features, formats, users (hook, demo, rest).
notFor: Items that need a line each; fewer than five items; films without a steady beat.

intent.en: A run of names felt rather than read: one word a beat, each catching the lens and retinting the whole frame, so the list becomes a metronome.
intent.zh: 一串名字用来“感受”而不是读：每拍一个词进取景框，整屏跟着换色调，清单成了节拍器。

content.en: A lead of 1–3 words (Chinese ≤ 4 characters), 5–10 one-word items (≤ 10 chars, Chinese ≤ 3 characters), a counter label and an optional tagline (≤ 28 chars, Chinese ≤ 12 characters).
content.zh: 引导词 1–3 个词（中文 ≤ 4 字），5–10 个单词条目（≤ 10 字符、中文 ≤ 3 字），一个计数标签，收尾标语可选（≤ 28 字符、中文 ≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 想让观众“感受到”而不是逐条读的五到十个名字：功能、格式、用户。

notFor.zh: 每项要配一行说明；不到五项；没有稳定节拍的片子。

en: Sound-dependent: put every jump on a kick of the bed; without the beat it reads as the UI twitching.
Jump in the first frames of the beat and hold still for the rest; a smooth scroll is just a list.
Give more words than jumps (beats + 2), or the list visibly runs out at the end.
zh: 强依赖声音：每次跳都对齐配乐的鼓点；没有节拍读成界面抽风。
跳只占拍头几帧，其余时间静止；匀速滚动就只是列表。
词数要比跳数多（拍数 + 2），否则最后露出“下面没了”。

upstream.name: 节拍列表换色
upstream.summary: 三通道节拍器——深色场形容词列表逐拍上移一行，视口中央固定胶囊"接住"下一个词并换色，整场底色同拍跟换；行、色、场三通道锁死同一拍点
upstream.use: "同一产品多种气质/多主题展示"段落（modern/playful/expressive 式形容词连打）；全片节奏最密的一段；音乐段对拍
upstream.energy: 高（0.6s 一拍三通道齐跳，密度型高能）

overlaps.note: stagger-in brings a list in; beat-list steps through a list that is already there, one row a beat
